name: Bonsai 2 27B
summary: Run a 27B reasoning, coding, and vision model on a laptop: ternary weights squeeze it to 5.9GB while keeping 98% of full-precision scores. 262K context, Apache 2.0, MLX builds for Mac and iPhone plus CUDA. Weights on Hugging Face.

name: Home MCP
summary: Point Claude, ChatGPT, or your own agent at your Nest and Matter devices over MCP to control lights, read camera summaries, or build a custom dashboard. A second Home Developer MCP feeds Home API docs into Claude Code and Cursor. US early access on Home Premium Advanced.

name: Claude Docs + Slides
summary: Ask for a doc or a deck in a normal chat and get an editable document or presentation you can edit in place, present, or export to Word, PowerPoint, or PDF. Cowork folds into chat too. Pro and Max first, Free and Team later.

name: Gemini 3.8 Live
summary: Build voice agents that reason and talk at once, call functions in the background mid-conversation, and see what the camera sees. Live in the Gemini API and AI Studio at $0.005 per minute in and $0.018 out, plus a new 3.5 Transcribe speech-to-text model.

name: Projects
summary: Hand a feature, migration, or app to a coordinator agent that plans the work, farms it out to parallel subagents in the cloud, and brings back results to review. Keeps context for months and runs on after you close the laptop. Beta for all users.

name: Agents API
summary: Build cloud agents on the same harness that runs Codex with one API call. It handles sessions, context compaction, sub-agents, and crash recovery, and you pick the sandbox. Public beta for all developers, no fee beyond tokens and tools.

name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
summary: Run a 1M-context multimodal model for pennies — $0.30 per million input tokens at peak, half that off-peak. It beats the older V4 Pro on speed and cost, and the 485B weights are up on Hugging Face.

name: ChatGPT Images 2.5
summary: Doodle a layout with @Sketch and get a finished image that follows it, with sharper detail, better reference-photo fidelity, and half the wait. Free for every ChatGPT tier. Two API models, Flare (fast) and Sunburst (precise), at $30 per million output tokens.
